result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.get_edge_creation_order()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Get edges in their creation order. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L3275-L3333){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.get_edge_creation_order() ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Returns edge IDs ordered by when they were added to the graph. The first edge created appears first, the most recently created edge appears last. Useful for temporal analysis or understanding edge addition patterns. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [list[int]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Edge IDs in chronological creation order. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Track edge creation order: ::: {#23771250 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ( ec.Graph() .add_node(label="A") .add_node(label="B") .add_node(label="C") .add_edge(source="A", target="B") .add_edge(source="B", target="C") .add_edge(source="C", target="A") ) creation_order = graph.get_edge_creation_order() # Returns 3 len(creation_order) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` 3 ``` ::: ::: ::: {#ca0f91c6 .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} # Get endpoints in creation order - iteration example for eid in creation_order: source, target = graph.get_node_ids_by_edge_id(eid) # Each iteration shows: Edge : -> ``` ::: Analyze edge addition patterns: ::: {#cfe4c666 .cell execution_count=3} ``` {.python .cell-code} graph = ec.Graph().add_path_graph(20) # Select first 10 edges added early_edges = graph.get_edge_creation_order()[:10] graph.select_edges_by_id(early_edges) # Check if edges were added chronologically by weight order = graph.get_edge_creation_order() weights = [graph.get_edge(eid).weight for eid in order] ``` :::
